acceptedHighFindings.rationale: On2026-10-16 the task owner explicitly approved the exact two glibc High identities, six repositories and deadline with "해당 범위·기한의 한시 수용 승인", after receiving the residual memory-corruption/crash risk and unchanged fail-closed release conditions. The prior approval expired2026-10-16 09:00KST and is not made retroactive. Limit to this exact High CVE/package/version in the existing six repositories through 2026-10-16 UTC (2026-10-17 09:00 KST), without automatic renewal. Six fresh COMPLETE candidate image scans on 2026-10-16 show only the two listed glibc High identities and zero Critical. Cyrus is absent from these scanner results, so remove its acceptance and reduce each repository maximum from3 to2; do not claim vendor remediation. Debian trixie still has no fixed glibc package. Read-only SSM d705d38b-98ef-4c81-bbf1-544919d603ae on verified development runtime source1c61 found no undefined dynamic reference to the five exact affected symbols across API909/AI1308/Tools863 ELF files and no scan errors; this does not exclude dlsym, static linking, other images or unexercised paths. Residual out-of-bounds write/crash risk remains. New identities, changed package/version, any Critical, expiry, native verification failures and all development/preprod/termination/rolling/real-use/cleanup gates remain fail-closed. The failed release is not retroactively approved. Review ownership and current evidence: docs/operations/container-image-security.md,2026-10-16 section.
